thread:
morgan (design): UX quick-hit: renamed 'burst' to 'burst cushion' in the compact autoscale row, adjusted helper text, and added a non-color visual for guardrail. Need product + a11y thumbs.
felix (product): naming check: 'burst cushion' feels softer but may be ambiguous. What's the proposed helper copy?
morgan (design): helper: 'Burst cushion: short-lived extra GPU capacity. Additional charges possible.' CTA under tooltip: 'How burst affects billing' linking to docs.
tara (eng): implementation note: tooltips will be lazy-mounted to avoid DOM churn in the virtual list; cap width at 320px and make them scrollable on small screens. We'll only show on focus/tap on touch devices.
hen (a11y): a11y: prefer 'additional charges possible' over 'charges may increase' — less alarming. Info icons need 44px hit targets; visible icon 18px. Tooltips must be dismissible with Esc and include aria-describedby.
morgan (design): added a guardrail chip: text 'safety cap' (instead of 'guardrail') with diagonal hatch when active. Tooltip: 'Safety cap active — autoscaler prioritizes latency; may use extra capacity.'
felix (product): 'safety cap' is clearer on the product side, good call. We should add a small non-numeric note under SLO: 'May affect cost' to signal tradeoffs without estimates.
tara (eng): SLO slider will sync with an inline number input. We'll ensure aria-valuemin/max/now on the slider and aria-describedby linking to the helper line. Also debounce any aria-live updates 1s to avoid screen reader spam.
hen (a11y): yes debounce and use aria-live="polite". For validation errors, announce via aria-live polite and don't rely on color. Also provide an sr-only label on icon triggers: 'More info about autoscale'.
morgan (design): keyboard flow: focusable Edit -> Min spinner -> Max spinner -> SLO slider -> Burst toggle -> Save/Cancel. Escape closes edit and returns focus to Edit.
tara (eng): noted. Virtualization means we must preserve focus on remount; will call focus() on the appropriate element after expand.
ci-bot: deploy queued: staging/autoscale-phrasing-v1 -> ~9m
felix (product): please test staging (keyboard, screen reader, mobile) and post any missed copy/aria issues back here. Thanks!
